page.overview:
Who is Lurker in the Star Pool?

The Lurker in the Star Pool is a fictional entity created by American author A. A. Attanasio for his 1980 short story "The Star Pools."

The Lurker in the Star Pool is one of the Million Favoured Ones, beings granted a new form by Nyarlathotep. It is described as a massive translucent blob full of a red gas with multiple heads resembling sharks and squids as well as gangly limbs and bat-like wings.

It dwells in the Star Pools, a collection of thousands of green ponds in Haiti.

Category:Other Supernatural Beings Category:Characters Originating From Expanded Mythos Works
